A full declared-for-year dollar figure is therefore not AS-DISCLOSED; nulled per as-disclosed-only rule.

rollforward.notes: Guard A + B - P = 34,254 + 56,944 - 60,492 = 30,706 (k) vs E = 34,695 (k); gap = +3,989 (k). NOT a misread. The gap is exactly the net of two additional DISCLOSED reconciliation lines that sit between the for-year subtotal (B=56,944) and the cumulative 'Amount available for distribution': 'Less: Amount retained for working capital (5,694)' and 'Add: Capital distribution 9,683', netting to +3,989. Full disclosed identity holds: A(34,254) + B(56,944) - retention(5,694) + capital_distribution(9,683) - P(60,492) = E(34,695). Simple A+B-P=E fails only because B is deliberately the pre-retention for-year subtotal as specified. Values in raw SGD ($'000 x 1000). Source: audited DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT OF THE STAPLED GROUP, year ended 31 December 2025, PAGE 209 marker.
